text:
Type: dark grey shag rug
Use: soft spot beside a bed, sofa or door; bedroom, living room, hallway, entryway
Style: contemporary, minimalist, modern
Materials: dense high pile synthetic shag
Colors: dark charcoal grey
Shape: small rectangle with thick even shag, soft edges, solid color, plush and cushy
Feel: cozy, soft, grounding
Goes with: white bedding, light wood, grey or black furniture, chrome accents; modern or minimalist bedrooms and living rooms

product.name: DUM
product.description: The dense, thick pile dampens sound and provides a soft surface to walk on.
